component.name: HyperLink
component.summary: Mirror and control a paired Samsung phone from Linux

description.p: HyperLink turns a Samsung phone and a Linux desktop into one continuous compute surface over a single low-latency QUIC tunnel — mirrored display, shared input, notifications, clipboard, and files — without depending on a closed vendor protocol or a cloud account.
Pairing uses Trust-On-First-Use certificate pinning confirmed by a 6-digit PIN shown on both devices; no account sign-in is required.
Phases 1-11: pairing, video mirroring, input, notifications, clipboard, file access, network resilience, proximity pre-warm, app-state handoff, ambient context agent, and production packaging.
